name: Ariane's Assistant
source:
Based on the Ariane Eldar comics (Theater of the Bloody Tongue etc.), the game follows a witchy burlesque star and classic rock fan. You play as a fan applying to be her assistant in a mix of dating sim and quiz.

[From [url=https://ritchierat.itch.io/arianes-assistant]Itch.io[/url]]
